chapter.title: The Interrogation
chapter.note: Rebuilt on 6 November 2026 from the PowerPyx 100% chart (31 nodes, four endings), the game’s own text (detroitbecometext template and string table) and the wiki’s and PowerPyx’s stress table. A hidden stress meter starts at 35%: the interrogation lines move it by 4% (the probe threat 8%), PRESSURE IT and each of up to four PRESSUREs by +10%, giving up the pressure by −20% (wiki; PowerPyx −5%), the convince lines by 7%; a successful probe sets it to 100%. Convince succeeds between 50% and 70%. After a confession the android goes to Chris below 70% and self-destructs above it or after four PRESSUREs. Endings: Android smashed his head, Android shot Connor and itself, Android shot itself, Android was sent back to its cell (plus ANDROID TRUSTS CONNOR after a convinced confession). Once it has analyzed the LED the subject sees the gauge band (TOO LOW / OPTIMAL / TOO HIGH / CRITICAL) in each scene and, after each change, the new percentage with its band, as the game’s gauge shows (story 1.9.2). Arrows: probe +1 instability; confession Hank +1; self-destruct INTERVENE instability −1; Chris GIVE UP with Connor shot instability −1 and Hank −1; third INTERVENE Hank +1; sent back to cell instability +1. Researched in docs/research/ch09-the-interrogation.md; recap in docs/ch09-the-interrogation-chapter-recap.html.

decisions.title: Look around the interrogation room
decisions.context: Before questioning the android from the attic: the case file on the table, the android itself (ANALYZE: five scans), the mirror.

options.label: REVIEW PHOTOS
options.effect: The crime-scene photos (PHOTOS OF CRIMESCENE). Unlocks SHOW PHOTOS.

options.label: ANALYZE (one action: PROCESSING LED, MODEL HK400, BURN MARKS, HIT MARKS, DRIED BLOOD)
options.effect: One scan records every clue on the android: the LED (“Signs of software instability / Probability of self-destruction: Low”, which shows the stress gauge and unlocks FEAR), the model and owner, cigarette burns over 16 months and baseball-bat damage (ANALYZE WOUNDS, unlocking WOUNDS), and Carlos Ortiz’s blood older than 19 days. Before story 1.9.6 these were five separate options; the operator confirmed in game (2026-11-07) that ANALYZE is a single action.

options.label: Look at the mirror
options.effect: Hank: “What the fuck is it doing now?”

options.label: INTERROGATE
options.effect: Sit down and begin.

decisions.gate: Suspect found in Partners (chart tag SUSPECT FOUND IN ‘PARTNERS’).
decisions.note: Chart nodes ANALYZE ANDROID, ANALYZE STRESS LEVEL, ANALYZE WOUNDS, REVIEW PHOTOS; the template’s observation group “Deviant”. No stat change.

benchmark.note: C06o is the OBSERVATION ROOM checkpoint (event). Then a free-roam scene, one scene id per visit (up to eight), until INTERROGATE. FEAR is tied to the LED scan and WOUNDS to the burn or hit marks (the template locks both on “Analyzed the deviant”).

decisions.title: Interrogation, first round
decisions.context: The android will not speak. Two picks.

options.label: FEAR
options.effect: No stress change. Needs the LED scanned.

options.label: SHOW PHOTOS
options.effect: Stress +4%. Needs the photos.

options.label: WOUNDS
options.effect: Stress +4%. Needs the wounds analyzed.

options.label: NAME
options.effect: Stress −4%. No response.

decisions.note: Not on the chart; drives the hidden stress meter (starts at 35%).

benchmark.note: Two scenes; the second drops the line already said and is skipped when nothing is left.

decisions.title: Interrogation, second round
decisions.context: “After two choices, you’ll get a different set of options.”

options.label: COMFORT
options.effect: Stress −4%.

options.label: REASSURE
options.effect: Stress −4%.

options.label: THREATEN
options.effect: Stress +4%.

options.label: BLAME
options.effect: Stress +4%.

decisions.note: How many picks this round takes is not published.

decisions.title: Interrogation, third round
decisions.context: “Then Connor can press the subject further.” Two picks, or one if the first is the probe threat.

options.label: SYMPATHIZE
options.effect: Stress −4%.

options.label: THREATEN
options.effect: Stress +4%.

options.label: PROBE MEMORY
options.effect: Stress +8%; the android panics (“NO! No, please don’t do that!..”) and the round ends at once.

options.label: TRUST
options.effect: Stress −4%.

benchmark.note: Two scenes; the second is skipped after PROBE MEMORY.

options.label: LIE
options.effect: Stress −4%.

options.label: TRUTH
options.effect: Stress +4%: “They’re going to disassemble you…”

decisions.title: “Why couldn’t you just have left me there?”
decisions.context: The android asks why Connor gave him up.

options.label: LIE
options.effect: Stress −4%: “…you would have been shot on sight.”

options.label: TRUTH
options.effect: Stress +4%: “I was programmed to hunt deviants like you.”

decisions.note: Ends with “I don’t wanna die.” / “Then talk to me.” / “I… I can’t…”

decisions.title: Choose approach
decisions.context: The android will not confess. PRESSURE IT, PROBE ITS MEMORY, CONVINCE IT; after a failure, another approach or GIVE UP; a second failure is an automatic give up.

options.label: PRESSURE IT
options.effect: Stress +10%, then up to four PRESSURE / GIVE UP prompts.

options.label: PROBE ITS MEMORY
options.effect: Quick-time event. Success: stress 100%, software instability up, Carlos’s voice in the flashback, then self-destruction. Failure: RESIST TO PROBE, back to the approach.

options.label: CONVINCE IT
options.effect: Three sets of lines at ±7%; succeeds only between 50% and 70%.

options.label: GIVE UP
options.effect: Only after a failed approach. “I’m not getting anywhere. I give up.” Leads to CHRIS INTERVENES.

decisions.note: Chart: CHOOSE APPROACH, PROBE MEMORY / CONVINCE / PRESSURE / GIVE UP with PROBE SUCCEEDS / RESIST TO PROBE and CONVINCING SUCCEEDS / CONVINCING FAILS.

benchmark.note: Two menus: C06 (no GIVE UP) and C06r (the failed approach removed, GIVE UP added). The probe carries a 10% risk (the benchmark’s figure; no source publishes one).

decisions.title: Pressure
decisions.context: Connor lays into the android: “28 stab wounds…”

options.label: PRESSURE
options.effect: Stress +10% each, four prompts. After the fourth (MAINTAIN PRESSURE) the android confesses and then self-destructs whatever his stress (wiki). Hank up on the confession.

options.label: GIVE UP
options.effect: Stress −20% (wiki; PowerPyx says −5%). “All right, all right. Everything is going to be okay.” Back to the approach menu.

benchmark.note: One scene per prompt, per approach round. The confession comes only after the fourth PRESSURE (open question 3).

decisions.title: Convince
decisions.context: Three sets: UNDERSTANDING / THREATEN / ORDER; SYMPATHIZE / INDIFFERENT / COMFORT; PROTECT / TERRIFY / WARN.

options.label: Calming lines (UNDERSTANDING, SYMPATHIZE, COMFORT, PROTECT)
options.effect: Stress −7% each.

options.label: Harsh lines (THREATEN, ORDER, INDIFFERENT, TERRIFY, WARN)
options.effect: Stress +7% each.

options.label: Result
options.effect: 50% to 70%: CONVINCING SUCCEEDS, the android confesses (Hank up). Otherwise CONVINCING FAILS, back to the approach menu.

benchmark.note: Three scenes per approach round; the objective “reach optimal stress for confession” is shown.

decisions.title: Express regret
decisions.context: After a successful probe Connor can turn back to the android before leaving.

options.label: APOLOGETIC
options.effect: “I had to know… You left me no choice.” Lights EXPRESS REGRET.

options.label: COLD
options.effect: “You’ll go back to CyberLife to be disassembled. It’s better this way.”

options.label: Say nothing
options.effect: Leave.

decisions.note: No stat change; the self-destruction follows either way.

benchmark.note: C06qs is CARLOS FLASHBACK (event, software instability +1 applied on the probe).

decisions.title: Questions after the confession
decisions.context: ANDROID CONFESSES (Hank up), then questions until all are asked.

options.label: WRITING
options.effect: Needs the writing on the wall in Partners.

options.label: STATUETTE
options.effect: Needs the statuette in Partners. Unlocks OFFERING.

options.label: OFFERING
options.effect: “To rA9… Only rA9 can save us.”

options.label: rA9
options.effect: Needs the shower writings in Partners. Unlocks INSIST rA9.

options.label: INSIST rA9
options.effect: No answer.

options.label: ATTIC
options.effect: Why he hid.

options.label: TRIGGER?
options.effect: When he started feeling.

benchmark.note: C06k is the confession (event, Hank +1). One scene per question; Partners clues are read defensively from that chapter’s state.

decisions.title: The android self-destructs
decisions.context: As Connor leaves, the android slams his head on the table (stress at 100%: a successful probe, a confession above 70%, or four PRESSUREs).

options.label: INTERVENE
options.effect: He takes the officer’s gun and shoots Connor, then himself: ANDROID SHOT CONNOR AND ITSELF. Software instability down; Connor dies.

options.label: GIVE UP (chart: DO NOTHING)
options.effect: He smashes his head until he dies: ANDROID SMASHED HIS HEAD.

benchmark.note: C06sd is ANDROID STARTS SELF-DESTRUCTING (event); C06s the choice.

decisions.title: Chris intervenes
decisions.context: Gavin orders Chris to lock the android up; Chris grabs him and he panics.

options.label: GIVE UP
options.effect: He takes Chris’s gun and shoots himself (ANDROID SHOT ITSELF); if Connor put him under stress (pressure, failed probe) and got no confession he shoots Connor first (ANDROID SHOT CONNOR AND ITSELF: software instability down, Hank down).

options.label: INTERVENE ×3
options.effect: Gavin draws on Connor, Hank draws on Gavin (Hank up); ANDROID WAS SENT BACK TO ITS CELL (software instability up). After a CONVINCE confession: ANDROID TRUSTS CONNOR, “The truth is inside.”

decisions.gate: A confession below 70% stress, or GIVE UP at the approach.
decisions.note: Outcome depends on the approach and the confession; intervening three times always saves him.

benchmark.note: C07a is CHRIS INTERVENES (event); three GIVE UP / INTERVENE prompts. Outputs for Waiting for Hank…: suspectAlive, suspectTrusts, ch09Confession, ch09ConnorDied, ch09HankProtected.
